question: L1₂構造を持つ化合物を一覧にして。
sql:

FROM material_entry me
JOIN structure s ON me.entry_id = s.entry_id

question: A₃B型組成を持つ化合物を表示して。

question: 形成エネルギーが負のL1₂型化合物を元素組み合わせごとに整理して。
sql:
SELECT
    array_agg(DISTINCT e.symbol ORDER BY e.symbol) AS elements,
    me.entry_id,
    me.formation_energy,
    ma.alloy_system_id,
    als.name AS alloy_system_name
FROM
    material_entry me
JOIN
    composition c ON me.entry_id = c.entry_id
JOIN
    element e ON c.element = e.symbol
JOIN
    material_alloy_system ma ON me.entry_id = ma.entry_id
JOIN
    alloy_system als ON ma.alloy_system_id = als.alloy_system_id
WHERE
    me.structure_type = 'L1₂'
    AND me.formation_energy < 0
GROUP BY
    me.entry_id,
    me.formation_energy,
    ma.alloy_system_id,
    als.name
ORDER BY
    elements
LIMIT 10000;

question: Ni₃Alに近い格子定数を持つL1₂化合物を探して。
sql:
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    s.lattice_constant,
    ABS(s.lattice_constant - ref_s.lattice_constant) AS lattice_constant_diff
FROM
    material_entry me
JOIN
    structure s ON me.entry_id = s.entry_id
JOIN
    material_entry ref_me ON ref_me.formula = 'Ni3Al'
JOIN
    structure ref_s ON ref_me.entry_id = ref_s.entry_id
WHERE
    me.structure_type = 'L12'
ORDER BY
    lattice_constant_diff
LIMIT 10000;

question: 化学系Al-Niに属するL1₂化合物を抽出して。

FROM material_entry me
JOIN material_alloy_system mas ON me.entry_id = mas.entry_id
JOIN alloy_system als ON mas.alloy_system_id = als.alloy_system_id
JOIN composition c1 ON me.entry_id = c1.entry_id
JOIN element e1 ON c1.element = e1.symbol
JOIN composition c2 ON me.entry_id = c2.entry_id
JOIN element e2 ON c2.element = e2.symbol

question: Aサイト元素ごとのL1₂型化合物数を集計して。

question: Cu含有のL1₂型化合物を安定性で分類して。
sql:

    me.entry_name,
    ps.stability,
    ma.domain_name AS application_domain,
    c.composition_formula
FROM
    material_entry me
JOIN
    phase_stability ps ON me.entry_id = ps.entry_id
JOIN
    composition c ON me.entry_id = c.entry_id
LEFT JOIN
    material_application ma ON me.entry_id = ma.entry_id

question: Bサイト元素ごとの平均形成エネルギーを出して。
sql:
SELECT
    comp_b.element AS b_site_element,
    AVG(md.formation_energy) AS average_formation_energy
FROM
    material_defect md
JOIN
    material_entry me ON md.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN
    composition comp_b ON me.entry_id = comp_b.entry_id
WHERE
    comp_b.site = 'B'
GROUP BY
    comp_b.element
ORDER BY
    b_site_element
LIMIT 10000;

question: 格子体積が12Å³/atom以下のL1₂化合物を出して。

FROM material_entry me

JOIN material_alloy_system mas ON me.entry_id = mas.entry_id
WHERE mas.alloy_system_id IN (

    FROM material_alloy_system mas2
    JOIN material_entry me2 ON mas2.entry_id = me2.entry_id
    WHERE me2.entry_name LIKE '%L1₂%'
)
AND (structure.lattice_volume / structure.num_atoms) <= 12
LIMIT 10000;

question: 2元素系のL1₂型化合物をchemical_systemで分類して。
sql:
SELECT
    ma.chemical_system,
    COUNT(DISTINCT me.entry_id) AS num_L12_compounds
FROM
    material_entry me
JOIN
    material_alloy_system ma ON me.entry_id = ma.entry_id
WHERE
    ma.chemical_system ~ '^[A-Z][a-z]?(\\+?[A-Z][a-z]?)?$' -- matches 1 or 2 elements
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM structure s
        WHERE s.entry_id = me.entry_id
          AND s.prototype = 'L1_2'
    )
GROUP BY
    ma.chemical_system
ORDER BY
    num_L12_compounds DESC
LIMIT 10000;

  cp_lattice_constant.value AS lattice_constant

question: L1₂化合物で安定性と格子定数の両面でNi3Alに近い候補を出して。
sql:
WITH target AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        ps.stability_energy,
        s.lattice_constant
    FROM
        material_entry me
        JOIN phase_stability ps ON me.entry_id = ps.entry_id
        JOIN structure s ON me.entry_id = s.entry_id
    WHERE
        me.entry_id IN (
            SELECT me2.entry_id
            FROM material_entry me2
            JOIN material_alloy_system mas ON me2.entry_id = mas.entry_id
            JOIN alloy_system als ON mas.alloy_system_id = als.alloy_system_id
            WHERE als.name = 'Ni3Al'
        )
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM material_alloy_system mas2
            JOIN alloy_system als2 ON mas2.alloy_system_id = als2.alloy_system_id
            WHERE mas2.entry_id = me.entry_id
              AND als2.name LIKE '%L1₂%'
        )
),
candidates AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.material_id,
        ps.stability_energy,
        s.lattice_constant,
        als.name AS alloy_system_name
    FROM
        material_entry me
        JOIN phase_stability ps ON me.entry_id = ps.entry_id
        JOIN structure s ON me.entry_id = s.entry_id
        JOIN material_alloy_system mas ON me.entry_id = mas.entry_id
        JOIN alloy_system als ON mas.alloy_system_id = als.alloy_system_id
    WHERE
        als.name LIKE '%L1₂%'
        AND me.entry_id <> (SELECT entry_id FROM target)
)
SELECT
    c.entry_id,
    c.material_id,
    c.alloy_system_name,
    c.stability_energy,
    c.lattice_constant,
    ABS(c.stability_energy - t.stability_energy) AS stability_diff,
    ABS(c.lattice_constant - t.lattice_constant) AS lattice_diff,
    (ABS(c.stability_energy - t.stability_energy) + ABS(c.lattice_constant - t.lattice_constant)) AS total_diff
FROM
    candidates c,
    target t
ORDER BY
    total_diff ASC
LIMIT 10000;

question: L1₂型化合物の元素組み合わせと安定性の関係をAサイト・Bサイト別に集計して材料設計の指針を得たい。
sql:
SELECT
  a_site_elements.elements AS a_site_elements,
  b_site_elements.elements AS b_site_elements,
  AVG(ps.stability_metric) AS avg_stability,
  COUNT(DISTINCT me.entry_id) AS compound_count
FROM
  material_entry me
JOIN
  phase_stability ps ON me.entry_id = ps.entry_id
JOIN
  composition comp_a ON me.entry_id = comp_a.entry_id AND comp_a.site = 'A'
JOIN
  composition comp_b ON me.entry_id = comp_b.entry_id AND comp_b.site = 'B'
JOIN
  element e_a ON comp_a.element = e_a.symbol
JOIN
  element e_b ON comp_b.element = e_b.symbol
JOIN (
  SELECT
    entry_id,
    STRING_AGG(DISTINCT element, ',' ORDER BY element) AS elements
  FROM composition
  WHERE site = 'A'
  GROUP BY entry_id
) a_site_elements ON me.entry_id = a_site_elements.entry_id
JOIN (
  SELECT
    entry_id,
    STRING_AGG(DISTINCT element, ',' ORDER BY element) AS elements
  FROM composition
  WHERE site = 'B'
  GROUP BY entry_id
) b_site_elements ON me.entry_id = b_site_elements.entry_id
WHERE
  me.structure_type = 'L1₂'
GROUP BY
  a_site_elements.elements,
  b_site_elements.elements
ORDER BY
  avg_stability DESC
LIMIT 10000;

question: Ni3Alの格子定数に近く、バルクモジュラスが高く、安定なL1₂候補を総合的にランキングして。

question: L1₂型化合物の安定性マップ（formation energy vs energy above hull）を出力して、候補を4象限に分類して。

    WHEN ps.formation_energy < 0 AND ps.energy_above_hull = 0 THEN 'Stable and low formation energy (Quadrant 1)'
    WHEN ps.formation_energy < 0 AND ps.energy_above_hull > 0 THEN 'Metastable and low formation energy (Quadrant 2)'
    WHEN ps.formation_energy >= 0 AND ps.energy_above_hull = 0 THEN 'Stable and high formation energy (Quadrant 3)'
    WHEN ps.formation_energy >= 0 AND ps.energy_above_hull > 0 THEN 'Metastable and high formation energy (Quadrant 4)'

  END AS stability_quadrant

  material_entry me
JOIN
  phase_stability ps ON me.entry_id = ps.entry_id
JOIN
  composition c ON me.entry_id = c.entry_id
WHERE
  me.material_id LIKE 'L1₂%'
GROUP BY
  me.entry_id,
  me.material_id,
  ps.formation_energy,
  ps.energy_above_hull
ORDER BY
  ps.formation_energy,
  ps.energy_above_hull
LIMIT 10000;

    avg(et.elastic_modulus) AS avg_elastic_modulus,
    avg(ds.dos_at_fermi) AS avg_dos_at_fermi,
    avg(bs.band_gap) AS avg_band_gap
FROM
    material_entry me
JOIN
    composition c ON me.entry_id = c.entry_id
JOIN
    element e ON c.element = e.symbol
JOIN
    phase_stability ps ON me.entry_id = ps.entry_id
LEFT JOIN
    material_application ma ON me.entry_id = ma.entry_id
LEFT JOIN
    application_domain ad ON ma.domain_id = ad.domain_id
LEFT JOIN
    calculated_property cp ON me.entry_id = cp.entry_id
LEFT JOIN
    thermal_property tp ON me.entry_id = tp.entry_id
LEFT JOIN
    elastic_tensor et ON me.entry_id = et.entry_id
LEFT JOIN
    density_of_states ds ON me.entry_id = ds.entry_id
LEFT JOIN
    band_structure bs ON me.entry_id = bs.entry_id
WHERE
    ps.is_stable = TRUE
    AND me.structure_type = 'L1₂'
GROUP BY
    me.entry_id,
    ps.stability_energy
ORDER BY
    ps.stability_energy ASC
LIMIT 10000;

question: 次世代γ'相候補として、Ni-Al-Co-Ti四元系でL1₂構造をとりうる組成を探索して。
sql:
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.entry_name,
    c.composition,
    mas.alloy_system_id,
    als.alloy_system_name,
    s.structure_name
FROM
    material_entry me
JOIN
    composition c ON me.entry_id = c.entry_id
JOIN
    material_alloy_system mas ON me.entry_id = mas.entry_id
JOIN
    alloy_system als ON mas.alloy_system_id = als.alloy_system_id
JOIN
    structure s ON me.entry_id = s.entry_id
WHERE
    als.alloy_system_name ILIKE '%Ni-Al-Co-Ti%'
    AND s.structure_name ILIKE 'L1₂%'
    AND c.composition ~* 'Ni'
    AND c.composition ~* 'Al'
    AND c.composition ~* 'Co'
    AND c.composition ~* 'Ti'
LIMIT 10000;
